verses.Genesis:1:1: In the beginning God created the heaven and the earth.
verses.Genesis:1:2: And the earth was without form, and void; and darkness was upon the face of the deep. And the Spirit of God moved upon the face of the waters.
verses.Genesis:1:3: And God said, Let there be light: and there was light.
verses.Psalms:1:1: Blessed is the man that walketh not in the counsel of the ungodly, nor standeth in the way of sinners, nor sitteth in the seat of the scornful.
verses.Psalms:1:2: But his delight is in the law of the LORD; and in his law doth he meditate day and night.
verses.Psalms:23:1: The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want.
verses.Psalms:23:2: He maketh me to lie down in green pastures: he leadeth me beside the still waters.
verses.Psalms:23:3: He restoreth my soul: he leadeth me in the paths of righteousness for his name's sake.
verses.Psalms:23:4: Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil: for thou art with me; thy rod and thy staff they comfort me.
verses.Psalms:23:5: Thou preparest a table before me in the presence of mine enemies: thou anointest my head with oil; my cup runneth over.
verses.Psalms:23:6: Surely goodness and mercy shall follow me all the days of my life: and I will dwell in the house of the LORD for ever.
verses.Psalms:91:1: He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most High shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty.
verses.Psalms:91:2: I will say of the LORD, He is my refuge and my fortress: my God; in him will I trust.
verses.Psalms:119:105: Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path.
verses.Proverbs:3:5: Trust in the LORD with all thine heart; and lean not unto thine own understanding.
verses.Proverbs:3:6: In all thy ways acknowledge him, and he shall direct thy paths.
verses.Isaiah:40:28: Hast thou not known? hast thou not heard, that the everlasting God, the LORD, the Creator of the ends of the earth, fainteth not, neither is weary? there is no searching of his understanding.
verses.Isaiah:40:29: He giveth power to the faint; and to them that have no might he increaseth strength.
verses.Isaiah:40:30: Even the youths shall faint and be weary, and the young men shall utterly fall:
verses.Isaiah:40:31: But they that wait upon the LORD shall renew their strength; they shall mount up with wings as eagles; they shall run, and not be weary; and they shall walk, and not faint.
verses.Isaiah:53:5: But he was wounded for our transgressions, he was bruised for our iniquities: the chastisement of our peace was upon him; and with his stripes we are healed.
verses.Isaiah:53:6: All we like sheep have gone astray; we have turned every one to his own way; and the LORD hath laid on him the iniquity of us all.
verses.Jeremiah:29:11: For I know the thoughts that I think toward you, saith the LORD, thoughts of peace, and not of evil, to give you an expected end.
verses.Matthew:5:3: Blessed are the poor in spirit: for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.
verses.Matthew:5:4: Blessed are they that mourn: for they shall be comforted.
verses.Matthew:5:5: Blessed are the meek: for they shall inherit the earth.
verses.Matthew:5:6: Blessed are they which do hunger and thirst after righteousness: for they shall be filled.
verses.Matthew:5:7: Blessed are the merciful: for they shall obtain mercy.
verses.Matthew:5:8: Blessed are the pure in heart: for they shall see God.
verses.Matthew:5:9: Blessed are the peacemakers: for they shall be called the children of God.
verses.Matthew:5:10: Blessed are they which are persecuted for righteousness' sake: for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.
verses.Matthew:5:11: Blessed are ye, when men shall revile you, and persecute you, and shall say all manner of evil against you falsely, for my sake.
verses.Matthew:5:12: Rejoice, and be exceeding glad: for great is your reward in heaven: for so persecuted they the prophets which were before you.
verses.Matthew:6:9: After this manner therefore pray ye: Our Father which art in heaven, Hallowed be thy name.
verses.Matthew:6:10: Thy kingdom come. Thy will be done in earth, as it is in heaven.
verses.Matthew:6:11: Give us this day our daily bread.
verses.Matthew:6:12: And forgive us our debts, as we forgive our debtors.
verses.Matthew:6:13: And lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil: For thine is the kingdom, and the power, and the glory, for ever. Amen.
verses.Matthew:28:18: And Jesus came and spake unto them, saying, All power is given unto me in heaven and in earth.
verses.Matthew:28:19: Go ye therefore, and teach all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Ghost:
verses.Matthew:28:20: Teaching them to observe all things whatsoever I have commanded you: and, lo, I am with you alway, even unto the end of the world. Amen.
verses.John:1:1: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.
verses.John:3:16: For God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son, that whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have everlasting life.
verses.John:3:17: For God sent not his Son into the world to condemn the world; but that the world through him might be saved.
verses.John:11:25: Jesus said unto her, I am the resurrection, and the life: he that believeth in me, though he were dead, yet shall he live:
verses.John:14:6: Jesus saith unto him, I am the way, the truth, and the life: no man cometh unto the Father, but by me.
verses.John:15:5: I am the vine, ye are the branches: He that abideth in me, and I in him, the same bringeth forth much fruit: for without me ye can do nothing.
verses.Acts:1:8: But ye shall receive power, after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you: and ye shall be witnesses unto me both in Jerusalem, and in all Judaea, and in Samaria, and unto the uttermost part of the earth.
verses.Romans:1:16: For I am not ashamed of the gospel of Christ: for it is the power of God unto salvation to every one that believeth; to the Jew first, and also to the Greek.
verses.Romans:3:23: For all have sinned, and come short of the glory of God;
verses.Romans:5:8: But God commendeth his love toward us, in that, while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.
verses.Romans:6:23: For the wages of sin is death; but the gift of God is eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.
verses.Romans:8:1: There is therefore now no condemnation to them which are in Christ Jesus, who walk not after the flesh, but after the Spirit.
verses.Romans:8:2: For the law of the Spirit of life in Christ Jesus hath made me free from the law of sin and death.
verses.Romans:8:3: For what the law could not do, in that it was weak through the flesh, God sending his own Son in the likeness of sinful flesh, and for sin, condemned sin in the flesh:
verses.Romans:8:4: That the righteousness of the law might be fulfilled in us, who walk not after the flesh, but after the Spirit.
verses.Romans:8:28: And we know that all things work together for good to them that love God, to them who are the called according to his purpose.
verses.Romans:8:38: For I am persuaded, that neither death, nor life, nor angels, nor principalities, nor powers, nor things present, nor things to come,
verses.Romans:8:39: Nor height, nor depth, nor any other creature, shall be able to separate us from the love of God, which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.
verses.Romans:10:9: That if thou shalt confess with thy mouth the Lord Jesus, and shalt believe in thine heart that God hath raised him from the dead, thou shalt be saved.
verses.Romans:10:10: For with the heart man believeth unto righteousness; and with the mouth confession is made unto salvation.
verses.Romans:12:1: I beseech you therefore, brethren, by the mercies of God, that ye present your bodies a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable unto God, which is your reasonable service.
verses.Romans:12:2: And be not conformed to this world: but be ye transformed by the renewing of your mind, that ye may prove what is that good, and acceptable, and perfect, will of God.
verses.1 Corinthians:13:1: Though I speak with the tongues of men and of angels, and have not charity, I am become as sounding brass, or a tinkling cymbal.
verses.1 Corinthians:13:2: And though I have the gift of prophecy, and understand all mysteries, and all knowledge; and though I have all faith, so that I could remove mountains, and have not charity, I am nothing.
verses.1 Corinthians:13:4: Charity suffereth long, and is kind; charity envieth not; charity vaunteth not itself, is not puffed up,
verses.1 Corinthians:13:13: And now abideth faith, hope, charity, these three; but the greatest of these is charity.
verses.2 Corinthians:5:17: Therefore if any man be in Christ, he is a new creature: old things are passed away; behold, all things are become new.
verses.Galatians:5:22: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, longsuffering, gentleness, goodness, faith,
verses.Galatians:5:23: Meekness, temperance: against such there is no law.
verses.Ephesians:2:8: For by grace are ye saved through faith; and that not of yourselves: it is the gift of God:
verses.Ephesians:2:9: Not of works, lest any man should boast.
verses.Ephesians:6:10: Finally, my brethren, be strong in the Lord, and in the power of his might.
verses.Ephesians:6:11: Put on the whole armour of God, that ye may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil.
verses.Philippians:4:6: Be careful for nothing; but in every thing by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known unto God.
verses.Philippians:4:7: And the peace of God, which passeth all understanding, shall keep your hearts and minds through Christ Jesus.
verses.Philippians:4:13: I can do all things through Christ which strengtheneth me.
verses.Colossians:3:23: And whatsoever ye do, do it heartily, as to the Lord, and not unto men;
verses.Hebrews:11:1: Now faith is the substance of things hoped for, the evidence of things not seen.
verses.Hebrews:11:6: But without faith it is impossible to please him: for he that cometh to God must believe that he is, and that he is a rewarder of them that diligently seek him.
verses.James:1:2: My brethren, count it all joy when ye fall into divers temptations;
verses.James:1:3: Knowing this, that the trying of your faith worketh patience.
verses.1 Peter:5:7: Casting all your care upon him; for he careth for you.
verses.Revelation:3:20: Behold, I stand at the door, and knock: if any man hear my voice, and open the door, I will come in to him, and will sup with him, and he with me.
verses.Revelation:21:4: And God shall wipe away all tears from their eyes; and there shall be no more death, neither sorrow, nor crying, neither shall there be any more pain: for the former things are passed away.
